## Combo 1494-3887-4613-7152
Cards: The Thing + Agatha's Soul Cauldron + Sage of Hours + Lab Rats
Color identity: WUBRG | Bracket: Ruthless | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: The Thing (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Agatha's Soul Cauldron (battlefield); Sage of Hours (exile: exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron); Lab Rats (hand)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.

  At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.

  Repeat each turn.

  Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2 until Vigor enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
  If Vigor dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
  Resolve Vigor's trigger, shuffling it into your library.
  Continue from step 3.

Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite death triggers; Put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield tapped
Start: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds (battlefield); Atla Palani, Nest Tender (battlefield); Grimgrin, Corpse-Born (battlefield); Cyclops of Eternal Fury (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
  Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
  Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
  Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.

  Repeat from step 2.
  Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
  Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Repeat.

## Combo 465-1115-3742-4251-4452
Cards: Phantom Steed + Godo, Bandit Warlord + Wormfang Drake + Hammer of Purphoros + Rukarumel, Biologist
Color identity: WUBRG | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite combat phases; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield
Start: Phantom Steed (battlefield); Godo, Bandit Warlord (battlefield); Wormfang Drake (exile: exiled by Phantom Steed); Hammer of Purphoros (battlefield); Rukarumel, Biologist (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
Steps: Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
  Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
  When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
  At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
  When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat each combat phase.
